fullDesc: In October 1986 US President Ronald Reagan and Soviet leader Mikhail Gorbachev met in Reykjavik, Iceland, and came close to a deal to eliminate nuclear weapons. It failed over Reagan's missile defence plans, but it set the stage for the 1987 INF treaty.
realFacts: The INF Treaty eliminated a class of missiles
Reagan called the Soviet Union an evil empire in 1983
Gorbachev won the Nobel Peace Prize in 1990
